Partner, Avaana Capital | Batch of 2009
FMS has been one of the most pivotal steps in my journey. It is one of the most rigorous to get in but most rewarding. I was collaborating with some of the smartest people in the country. A big part of me is a result of my time at FMS, and I am extremely proud to be associated with the institution!
Priya Ramdev
Chief People Officer, McKinsey & Company | Batch of 2005

The past decades have witnessed a significant growth in the nature and number of programmes offered at the FMS. FMS has exchange programmes and collaborative arrangements with leading industrial and business houses, management institutions and professional associations in India and abroad. It is the founder member of the Association of Management Development Institutions in South Asia (AMDISA) and is working towards regional cooperation in management education and development in the spirit of SAARC.
